analyst.summary: Tilaknagar Industries' reported revenue nearly tripled this past quarter, but that headline is driven almost entirely by consolidating the newly acquired Imperial Blue whisky business, not organic growth — and profit actually fell as integration and input costs bit. The stock trades at a very rich ~198x earnings, pricing in a smooth multi-year integration that has not yet shown up in the bottom line. We rate it a Hold, with the growth headline needing to be read carefully rather than taken at face value.
